whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Dryclean Care for Long Coats?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Tailoring depends on layers — shell fabric, canvas, interfacing and lining — that shrink at different rates in water. Here is why tailored pieces need professional dryclean care:

points.title: Structure Holds
points.desc: No water means canvas and interfacing do not shrink, bubble or separate from the shell fabric.

points.title: Shoulders & Lapels
points.desc: Shoulders are pressed on a form and lapels rolled by hand, never flattened on a board.

points.title: Wool Without Shine
points.desc: Steam finishing through a cloth keeps wool from turning shiny at the seams and pockets.

points.title: Linings Stay Put
points.desc: Linings are cleaned with the shell so nothing puckers or hangs below the hem.

points.title: Sharp Creases
points.desc: Trouser creases are set cleanly along the original line — not a second, doubled crease.

points.title: Delivered Hung
points.desc: Returned on a hanger in a cover, ready to wear rather than folded into new creases.

categories.detail: Collar and underarm build-up from a long day

stainTreatment.disclaimer: Treatment results depend on the type of stain, fabric condition, age of the stain and any previous treatment. We use professional spot-lifting techniques, but complete removal cannot be guaranteed for every aged or heat-set mark.

faqs.a: Dryclean & Press for long coats starts from {price1} per piece. Prices are exclusive of 18% GST, and pickup and delivery are free.

faqs.q: How long does long coat dry cleaning take?
faqs.a: Dryclean & Press for long coats usually takes 24–48 hours.

faqs.q: When should I get my winter coat drycleaned?
faqs.a: Before you store it at the end of winter. Dirt and body oils left in the wool over summer attract moths and set in, so a clean coat stores much better.

faqs.q: Can you remove stains from long coats?
faqs.a: Visible stains are identified and pre-treated before the main clean. Results depend on the type and age of the stain, the fabric and any earlier home treatment, so complete removal cannot be guaranteed for every mark.
